annotations.title: Share an app with a link

description: Share an internal app, show it to a client or a tester without a while account: requests a sharing link (access link); a person creates it and passes it on in while. With dev_address: the workstation's dev address (its dev server), 7 days at most.

dev_address.description: The name of a dev address (what follows -dev- in <project>-dev-<name>): share it rather than an environment.

name.description: The proposed name of the link ("Dupont client demo").

name: request_access_link
